acceptance_criteria.text: gate.yml declares an optional workflow_call input `runner`: type string, default `ubuntu-latest`, not required, with a description that says it applies only to the secret-free tests and measure jobs.
positive: The input block exists with type string, default ubuntu-latest, required false
negative: A required: true or a non-string type would fail the test
edge: The description names both `tests` and `measure` and says no secrets
regression: The existing inputs release-key-fingerprint and allow-unsigned are unchanged

acceptance_criteria.text: Exactly the `tests` and `measure` jobs of gate.yml set `runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner }}`.
negative: No other job of gate.yml uses the input
edge: Exactly two runs-on lines in gate.yml read the input
regression: Both jobs keep permissions: contents: read and no secrets

acceptance_criteria.text: The `story-gate` job of gate.yml, audit.yml and dashboard.yml run on a hard-coded `ubuntu-latest` and never mention `inputs.runner`.
negative: audit.yml and dashboard.yml do not contain inputs.runner anywhere
edge: The story-gate job text contains neither inputs.runner nor a ${{ expression in runs-on
regression: Secrets are still read only in the story-gate job

acceptance_criteria.text: When `runner` is not passed, every job of gate.yml, audit.yml and dashboard.yml resolves to `ubuntu-latest`.
positive: Resolving inputs.runner to its default gives ubuntu-latest for every job
negative: A default other than ubuntu-latest would fail the test
edge: Callers can pass a Ubicloud label and only tests and measure change
regression: The existing workflow-pinning and no-secrets test still passes

acceptance_criteria.text: A caller that passes `runner` by hand in the `with:` block of its story-gate.yml is accepted by `story-gate doctor`. How `story-gate install` treats that line is stated in the PR.
positive: doctor reports ok for a caller file that also sets runner: ubicloud-standard-2
negative: doctor still rejects a caller file with a second uses: line or its own steps
edge: A runner value with a dash and digits is accepted
regression: The caller files install writes still pass doctor with no runner line

proposed_missing_acs: install --ci reusable should carry a runner choice through (a --runner flag). Today it drops a hand-added runner line when it rewrites the caller file. That needs a change in sg_reusable.py, outside this story.
